options.name: config
options.description: A list of BGP process configuration.

options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the NX-OS device by executing the command B(show running-config | section '^router bgp'). The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in. State I(deleted) only removes BGP attributes that this modules manages and does not negate the BGP process completely. Refer to examples for more details.
